name: @561-group/aletheon
description: Aletheon: a browser 3D fantasy MMORPG whose world-truth is voidmath. The realm is settled out of the Void — every vital fact is a bilattice cell (⊥ unknown / t real / f destroyed / ⊤ contradiction-held-as-a-situation). The authoritative server folds an append-only EAVT trace through the cleaned-up voidmath kernel; the browser renders a streamed view with a from-scratch zero-dependency WebGL2 engine and rederived vec/mat/quat math. Zero dependencies, zero build, pure ESM. Served at aletheon.561.group (declared via the 561:serve block).

scripts.test: node tests/math.test.mjs && node tests/world.test.mjs && node tests/net.test.mjs
